scope: Offline geometric reconstruction only; no ROS, simulation, build, motion, runtime mutation or grasp acceptance in this analysis.

input_angles.provenance: Parent task supplied scene12 GRASP_CONFIRM target and stable measured angle; measured value is rounded to eight decimal places, not independently re-extracted in this audit.

algorithm.vertex_precision: OBJ decimal vertices cast to IEEE float32 before widening to float64, reproducing Assimp mesh import precision; target reverse interpolation matches supplied target within 2e-15 rad. Decimal-only reconstruction differs by 0.387 nm width.
steps: Parse saved URDF joints and mimic multipliers; compose URDF origin Rz(yaw)Ry(pitch)Rx(roll) and local joint axis rotation from arm_left_link_7.
Load actual READY installed collision OBJ vertices, apply mesh scale and collision origin, take per-link axis-aligned min/max.
Transform all eight link AABB corners into TCP coordinates, project onto normalized +X, take separation of inward interval faces.
Sample q=i*0.93/60 for i=0..60 and linearly interpolate exactly as runtime jawWidthAtAngle; invert monotonic sampled width table.
algorithm.analytic_decimal_gap_m: 2*(0.0145 + 0.04125*cos(q) - 0.036379080527138*sin(q) - 0.005*cos(0.03) - 0.0663*sin(0.03)); for imported mesh equivalence cast 0.005 and 0.0663 through float32.
algorithm.upstream_moveit_contract: LinkModel getShapeExtentsAtOrigin and getCenteredBoundingBoxOffset describe link-local AABB including collision origins; local dependency link_model.cpp lines 96-115 confirmed mesh vertex accumulation.

conclusion: The commanded 56 mm opening requires approximately 4 mm geometric compression/penetration of the 60 mm rigid static box. The observed angle corresponds to approximately 59.9317 mm; original angular error 0.0388352 rad exceeds the unchanged 0.02 rad endpoint limit. A 60 mm zero-preload target predicts only about 0.0006810 rad difference from this observed angle.
minimal_change_recommendation: Explicitly set grasp_preload_m=0 only in simulation-only MTC planning for this rigid kinematic payload; retain generic GripperCommander 4 mm default, endpoint tolerance 0.02 rad, collision/scene checks and physical attachment confirmation. Re-run the same parent PICK-NAV-PLACE action and require real endpoint convergence before attachment.
limits: AABB jaw width is the existing planning metric, not independent signed mesh contact distance.
The actual input q is rounded; last reported numeric digits are arithmetic precision, not measurement precision.
Rigid-body contact solver can have small penetration; actual ~0.0683 mm apparent deficit does not imply object compressibility.
No contact-force, force-closure, stable dynamic grasp, attachment, loaded navigation, placement or hardware acceptance is established.
Package file hashes bind the currently inspected READY installation; the scene runtime manifests identify that READY profile, but no separate historical per-mesh snapshot was recorded.
